content: Tuma Pirda
«Wordo yo7o laallofa; wordo markkattada iita as maaddofa.
«Iita miish ooththanaas daro asa kaallofa; pirda mirqqanaas daro asaara gidada markkattofa.
Manqo asi pirdaso shiiqikko iza manqoteth be7ada maadda pirdofa.
«Ne morkke booray woykko harey dhaydayssa demmiko izaades zaara imma.
Nena ixxiza asas harey caanara kundi dishin be7ikko izara maadettada denththa attiin heen agaagoppa.
«Pirdas dubbushan shiiqada, manqo asa pirda wobbisoppa.
Wordo mooto siyoppa; geesh woykko xillo as hayqos aaththa immofa; ays giikko mooro ooththidaade tani mela yeddike.
«Matta7e ekkofa; aazas giikko matta7ey xeellizayta ayfe qooqiseessinne xillota qaala mirqqees.
«Hara dereppe yida bete as qohoppite; bete as gideththi ay mala deexxizaakko intte ereeta; ays giikko intte intte hu7en bete gididi Gibxe biittan de7ideta.
Laappunththa Layththinne Laappunththa Gallas
«Usuppun layth gakkanaas ne goyada zerida kaththa maxa shiishsha.

Laappunththa layththan gadeza goyontta shaachcha; histtiko ne dere garsan diza manqoti hessafe maana kath demmana; qasse isttafe attizayssa do7ati maana. Neni ne woyne tokkiza gade bollanne zayte immiza wogara miththa gade bollaka hessaththo ooththa.
«Usuppun gallas ne ooso ooththa; ne booraynne ne harey shempana malanne neson yelettida aylleynne bete asi, shempana mala, laappunththa gallas ooso ooththofa.
«Tani inttena gidayssa ubbaa minththidi ooththite; hara xoossata sunth xeygopitenne istta woossofte.
Gita Ba7aaleta
«Layththan heedzdzuto intte taas ba7aale bonchchite.

Abibe geetettiza aginan barettida gallassan ukeththa ba7aale bonchchite; ays giikko intte Gibxeppe keziday he aginanna. Tani inttena azazida mala laappun gallas irshoy gelontta uketh miite. «Inttefe issaadeyka ta sinththan mela kushe beettofo.

«Qasse intte intte gaden zeriin, koyro gakkida kath maxiza wode, kaththa xeera shiishshiza ba7aale bonchchite. «Qasseka layththaa wurseththan, kath ubbaa shiishshi wursiza wode, kaththa shiisho ba7aale bonchchite.
Addeti wuri ubbaa Haariza GODAA ta sinth layththan heedzdzuto yetto.
«Neni yarsho suuth taas shiishshashe irshora uukettida ukeththara shiishshofa. He ba7aaleza bonchchiza gallas yarshettida moodheppe maalados aykkoyka attofo.
Ne gaden bayra kaxxida kaththa ubbaafe lo7izayssa GODAA ne Xoossaa soo ekka ya. Deyshsha laaqqa iza aayey maaththan doyssofa.
Hidota Qaalatanne Kaalliza Wogata
«Ne ogen nena naagana malanne tani nees giigsidaso nena efana mala, tani kiitanchcha ne sinththara yeddana.
Izi yootizayssa ero gaada izas azazetta; iza bolla makkallofa; ta iza kiittida gishshas intte nagara ooththiko inttes izi atto geenna.
Izi yootizayssa intte lo7eththi siyikko, tani yootizayssa ubbaa ooththiko intte morkketa ubbaa tani morkkana; inttenara eqettizaytara tanikka eqettana.
Ta kiitanchchay inttefe sinththe biidi, inttena Amooreta biitta, Hiiteta biitta, Paarizeta biitta, Kanaaneta biitta, Hiiweta biittanne Yaabuseta biitta efana. Tani istta mulera dhayssana.
Istta eeqata sinththan hokkofte, woykko goynnofte, woykko istta hano qullofte. Intte istta dhayssanaassinne tuussa mala eqqi diza istta shuchcha eeqata menththereththanaas bessees.
GODAA intte Xoossaas goynnite; histtiko, izi inttena kaththaninne haaththan anjjana; ta intte giddofe harge diggana.
Intte biittan ay maccasika boshettennanne maynenna. Tani intte daana layth adussana.
«Inttenara gaaggiza dereta ubbaa daganththana mala tani ta yashshateth intte sinththara yeddana; intte morkketi wuri inttes zokko zaaridi, baqatana mala ta ooththana.
Tani inttefe sinththara kazhe yeddada Hiiweta, Kanaanetanne Hiiteta goodda kessana.
Gido attiin biittay kallo attontta malanne do7ay darontta mala, ta istta issi layththa garsan gooddike.
Gido attiin intte qoodan daridi, he biittaa laattana gakkanaas, tani istta guuth guuth goodda kessana.

Tani intte zawaa Zo7o abbaafe Mediteraane abbaa gakkanaas, bazzofe Efiraaxise shaafaa gaththana. He biittan dizaaz ubbaa tani intte kushen aaththa immana; intteka istta intte sinththafe gooddi kessana.
Isttara woykko istta eeqa xoossatara caaqon gelopite.
Istta intte biittan woththofte; intte histtontta aggiko istti inttena ta bolla nagara oosisana; ays giikko istta eeqatas goynnizayssi tumappe inttes narxa gidana» gides.
